en: Gains enhancements based on the Alliance with the highest current Stacks: each Alliance Stack grants self ASPD <@ba.vup>+1</>, and attacks additionally inflict <@ba.vup>0.1%</> <$ba.fragile>Fragile</> for 2 seconds (up to 300 Stacks)

Battlefield #05 (Second Half) Originium Flow Generator

Blows an airflow 3 tiles forward; Operators deployed <@ba.vup>with</>/<@ba.vdown>against</> the airflow have ATK <@ba.vup>increased</>/<@ba.vdown>decreased</>; enemies moving <@ba.vdown>with</>/<@ba.vup>against</> it have Movement Speed <@ba.vdown>increased</>/<@ba.vup>decreased</>
Cannot be attacked; restores HP of nearby friendly units
Self-destructs automatically after <@ba.vup>10</> seconds
Enemies within range have ATK and DEF <@ba.vup>-25%</>
Enemies within range have ATK and DEF <@ba.vup>-30%</>
On appearing, deals Arts damage equal to <@ba.vup>200%</> of ATK to nearby enemies and <$ba.stun>Stuns</> them for <@ba.vup>1</> second
On appearing, deals Arts damage equal to <@ba.vup>230%</> of ATK to nearby enemies and <$ba.stun>Stuns</> them for <@ba.vup>1.5</> seconds
Can block 2 enemies; reduces the DEF of blocked units
On appearing, <$ba.stun>Stuns</> nearby enemies for <@ba.vup>2</> seconds
On appearing, <$ba.stun>Stuns</> nearby enemies for <@ba.vup>2.5</> seconds

Can block 2 enemies. In <@ba.kw>Integrated Strategies</>, the Stun on appearing lasts 5 seconds, and the DEF reduction on blocked enemies is replaced by reducing the DEF of ground enemies in the surrounding 8 tiles by <@ba.kw>-400</> and RES by <@ba.kw>-20</> (does not stack)
Its Attack Range counts as an extension of Skadi the Corrupting Heart's Attack Range

When deployed, deals True damage equal to <@ba.vup>90%</> of Nearl the Radiant Knight's ATK to enemies in the surrounding 4 tiles and <$ba.stun>Stuns</> them for <@ba.vup>3</> seconds; deals one additional hit if the previously deployed Operator's faction is [Kazimierz]

When deployed, deals True damage equal to <@ba.vup>100%</> of Nearl the Radiant Knight's ATK to enemies in the surrounding 4 tiles and <$ba.stun>Stuns</> them for <@ba.vup>3</> seconds; deals one additional hit if the previously deployed Operator's faction is [Kazimierz]

Gains a "Wolf Shadow" every 25 seconds (up to 3); for each "Wolf Shadow", the Wolf Pack's Block +1 and each attack deals one additional hit; when there is more than 1 "Wolf Shadow", upon taking lethal damage, loses one "Wolf Shadow" but restores all HP
Ignores 175 DEF of the target when attacking blocked targets
Initially deals <@ba.kw>Arts damage</>; can only be deployed within the summoner's Attack Range

Can copy one Operator in the deployment zone. If ranged, gains the trait: every <@ba.vup>10</> attacks, splits itself onto a deployable tile in the surrounding 4 tiles (lasts <@ba.vup>25</> seconds); if melee, each attack <$ba.steal>steals</> <@ba.vup>10</> ATK and DEF from the enemy (up to <@ba.vup>250</>, resets after copying)

When the skill is activated, copies 90% of the target's HP, ATK, DEF and RES, as well as its Block, Attack Interval, Attack Range and initial damage type (non-attacking and healing types are not inherited)

When the skill is activated, copies 100% of the target's HP, ATK, DEF and RES, as well as its Block, Attack Interval, Attack Range and initial damage type (non-attacking and healing types are not inherited)

Deals Physical damage to the first enemy it touches and <$ba.sluggish>Slows</> the target
<@ba.rem>The Champagne Bomb can deal one additional hit after being on the field for 3 seconds</>
Ulpianus returns to this position when his skill ends; other Operators cannot be deployed here
Can block 1 enemy; attacks deal <@ba.kw>True damage</>

Grants one friendly Operator within Attack Range a <$ba.barrier>Barrier</> equal to 20% of Catherine's Max HP (if the target has not been attacked in the last 5 seconds, replenishes a <$ba.barrier>Barrier</> equal to 6% of Catherine's Max HP per second, not exceeding the initial cap); device effects do not stack; lasts indefinitely
Added to the deployment zone while Silverash the Reignfrost is on the field. DP Cost changes with Silverash the Reignfrost's skill
Increases the Initial SP of the Operator on the left and reduces its Redeploy Time

When the first Operator is deployed during "Change Has Come", the "Eye of the Blizzard" is deployed to that Operator's position and performs <@ba.vup>linear AoE attacks</> simultaneously with Silverash the Reignfrost. It can be redeployed during the skill to change position, with its <@ba.vup>DP Cost refunded</>
A friendly unit summoned when 6 members of [Yan] are active; at battle start, ATK/HP increased by 30% of the total ATK/HP of [Yan] Operators (see bonds.json yanShip)

Attack Range <@ba.vup>+2</>, ATK <@ba.vup>+40%</>, heals <@ba.vup>2</> targets at a time, and additionally heals the target or 1 friendly unit adjacent to it once, for <@ba.vup>30%</> of the main target's healing amount. Healing on friendly units at or below half HP increased to <@ba.vup>150%</>
Gains 5 SP when a friendly Operator within Attack Range is defeated
